svg.aria-label: MySher Aviary — Quezon City · Freelance. A bird marketplace and management platform: customer-facing features, REST APIs, backend services and database workflows on React, Express.js, Supabase and PostgreSQL — built through feature branches and pull requests, with AI-assisted code reviewed, debugged and tested by hand.
